title: Risk-Averse Decision Making with Multi-Level Reliability Guarantees
abstract: arXiv:2609.11524v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Many applications in engineering, including wireless broadcasting, require designs that provide performance certificates at different target outage levels. This paper studies the problem of maximizing the weighted average of such certificates in the presence of uncertainty about the true system state. The problem is shown to be equivalent to an optimization over nested prediction sets, connecting to the literature on conformal prediction and extending prior art on single-level risk-averse decision making. Furthermore, we derive a dual formulation that decouples optimization across input values. Numerical experiments on a diversity-based wireless transmission system illustrate the cost of enforcing multi-level certificates with a single shared policy and trace the Pareto trade-off between multiple reliability levels.

translated_title: 具有多级可靠性保证的风险规避决策
translated_abstract: 工程领域的许多应用（包括无线广播）都需要能够在不同目标中断水平下提供性能证书的设计。本文研究了在真实系统状态存在不确定性的情况下，最大化此类证书加权平均值的问题。我们证明了该问题等价于对嵌套预测集进行的优化，从而与保形预测的文献建立联系，并扩展了单级风险规避决策的已有研究。此外，我们推导了一种对偶形式，将跨输入值的优化解耦。在基于分集的无线传输系统上进行的数值实验说明了用单一共享策略实施多级证书的代价，并刻画了多个可靠性水平之间的帕累托权衡。
tldr: 本文证明具有多级可靠性保证的风险规避决策等价于嵌套预测集上的优化问题，通过对偶形式实现跨输入解耦优化，并以无线传输实验揭示了多级可靠性水平之间的帕累托权衡。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that risk-averse decision making with multi-level reliability guarantees is equivalent to optimization over nested prediction sets, derives a dual formulation that decouples optimization across inputs, and illustrates the Pareto trade-off between multiple reliability levels through wireless transmission experiments.
